title: DSSSB PGT Math Cutoff and Marks 2026
postName: Post Graduate Teacher (Mathematics) – Male & Female, DoE (Post Code 825/24)
vacancyDetails: Marks and e-dossier shortlist released for PGT (Maths) Male and Female in Directorate of Education under DSSSB Post Code 825/24
qualification: Post Graduate degree in Mathematics with B.Ed. / as per DSSSB PGT Maths recruitment rules
ageLimit: As per DSSSB Post Code 825/24 notification
applicationFee: As per DSSSB online application fee

1. Visit https://dsssb.delhi.gov.in
2. Open Results section

shortDescription: DSSSB has released PGT Mathematics (Male & Female) marks and cutoff for e-dossier on 31 July 2026 under Post Code 825/24. Check notice at dsssb.delhi.gov.in.
content:
The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the notice for marks and calling of e-dossiers for Post Graduate Teacher (Mathematics) – Male and Female in the Directorate of Education (DoE) under Post Code 825/24.

The notice (dated 31 July 2026) contains category-wise normalised cutoff marks of the last shortlisted candidates for both Male and Female posts, including PwBD categories where applicable.

What candidates should do

  • Download the official cutoff / marks notice PDF from dsssb.delhi.gov.in
  • Confirm shortlisting status as per category
  • Upload e-dossier documents within the timeline mentioned in the notice

Only shortlisted candidates will be considered for further document verification and nomination. Always rely on the official DSSSB PDF for exact cutoffs.
